provenance.description: Frozen copies of the existing local benchmark reports, not recordings of user-operated missions. Archival does not change the recorded measurements.
provenance.sourceRevision: Current local patrol/population baseline archived with this manifest; not the prior HEAD ad07d4e46f82b52f2fde537075a53e36c9b6413d.

common.planner: Uniform balanced closed-loop patrol; population affects evaluation, not routes.
limitations: Overhead circular sensing without building occlusion.
Static clustered population assigned to sample points, not individual moving pedestrians.
No real-city visibility, battery, weather, takeoff, or browser frame-rate claims.
Fleet recommendation is conservative within this route family, not proof of global optimality.

performance.aggregation: Means average equal-duration samples and equal-size seed scenarios. Hotspot on-time is population weighted.

cases: Five drones: malfunction of each drone (5 scenarios).
Five drones: deviation of each drone (5 scenarios).
Six drones: malfunction of each drone (6 scenarios).
Five drones: drone 1 malfunction at 600 seconds, restored at 900 seconds (1 scenario).
faults.recovery: Area freshness >=95% for at least 120 seconds; separately records a sustained interval through the end of the observed run.
faults.hotspotMetric: Percent of hotspot cells meeting deadlines, not percent of hotspot residents; do not mix with performance.json hotspot population weighting.

fidelity.method: Analytical swept footprints on periodic healthy routes, evaluated on independent spatial midpoint grids.

reproduction.outputPolicy: Scripts create test-results/ if necessary and write only fresh reports there; they never overwrite this frozen baseline.
reproduction.comparison: Compare parsed JSON, ignoring top-level createdAt and wallSeconds in performance.json. Other values must match; floating-point differences across runtimes should be investigated rather than silently accepted.
